Implement Commands 003+004: Foundation Utilities Bundle

Foundation utilities implementation med helpers og value converters:

Command 003 - Helpers & Extensions:
- Constants.cs: Milestone days [7,21,30,60,90,180,365], settings keys, defaults
- DateTimeExtensions.cs: IsToday(), IsFutureDate(), GetDaysAgo(), FormatRelative(), GetWeekDates()
- ColorExtensions.cs: ToMauiColor(), ToHexString(), WithOpacity()
- StringExtensions.cs: IsNullOrWhiteSpace(), Truncate(), ToTitleCase()

Command 004 - Value Converters:
- BoolToColorConverter: bool → Color (completion status)
- InverseBoolConverter: bool → !bool
- IntToVisibilityConverter: int → visibility (show if > 0)
- DateToStringConverter: DateTime → formatted string (relative, short, long)
- StreakToColorConverter: streak → gradient color (gray/light green/green/dark green)
- EmptyStringToVisibilityConverter: string → visibility

- Alle converters registreret i Styles.xaml
- Namespace xmlns:converters tilføjet
- Converters tilgængelige via {StaticResource}
